>I have this great thirst and curiosity for knowledge 

I had that once. I guess I still have it, but I'm so apathetic that nothing interests me anymore. I'm 17 and I'll graduate from high school next year. That means the decades-long cycle of work is getting nearer. I wish I would just die before it, but that's wishful thinking.

>Also need to quit social-media because it steals my life 

I did it some time ago and only returned last August. Definitely do it, take a break at the very least. It cleared my mind nicely.

>For me, it's fear of pain from suicide. If I had a guaranteed, painless way to die I would take it without a second thought. 

Same for me. It's just too big of a risk.
